title: Shabihe payambar akber
body:
Shabihe payamber akber nouha kare maa
Shaah ka dilbar akber nouha kare maa
Armaan bohot tha mai teri shaadi rachaau
Ek roz dulhan chaand si mai byaah ke laau Par laash pa roti hai teri kokh jali maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Zinda the tumhe dekh ke ab kaise jienge
Soncha tha tere byaah ki poshak siyenge
Par tujh ko kafan bhi na mila haaye meri jaa'n
Bimaar behen takti hai beta tera rasta
<<DIVIDER>>
pardes me aaye to raha yaad na waada
Maqtal kiya aabaad madina kiya veeraa'n
Rothi hai phupi jis ne tuhjhe laad se paala
Tum kya gaye ruqsat hua is ghar ka ujaala
<<DIVIDER>>
Ek baap zaeefi me hua be saro saamaa'n
Allah nigehbaan tumhara mere pyare
Hum log rasan basta hue shaam sidhaare
Sota hai tere sath yahaa'n asghare naadaa'n
